marketFundamentalsNoCompany.en: Company fundamentals are not available for index futures.
marketFundamentalsNoCompany.zh: 指數期貨沒有公司基本面資料。

marketFundamentalsNoRevenue.en: Monthly revenue is unavailable from the current official feed.
marketFundamentalsNoRevenue.zh: 目前官方來源沒有可用的月營收資料。

marketFundamentalsNoStatements.en: Quarterly statements are not available for this company in the current public feed.
marketFundamentalsNoStatements.zh: 目前公開來源沒有這家公司的季財報資料。

marketFundamentalsNoRecords.en: No stored records are available for this statement.
marketFundamentalsNoRecords.zh: 目前沒有已保存的這類財報資料。

marketFundamentalsNoPriorQuarter.en: Preceding quarter is unavailable; values remain cumulative.
marketFundamentalsNoPriorQuarter.zh: 前一季資料缺少，保留累計申報值。

marketFundamentalsRefreshFailed.zh: 更新失敗，顯示快取資料

marketFundamentalsHistoryPending.zh: 歷史資料蒐集中，稍後自動更新

marketFundamentalsCashConversion.zh: 營業現金流 ÷ 稅前淨利

marketFundamentalsCapexToOcf.zh: 資本支出 ÷ 營業現金流

marketFundamentalsCashFlowNote.en: Cash flow statements are year-to-date, so changes compare with the same period last year.
marketFundamentalsCashFlowNote.zh: 現金流量表為年初至今累計，故只與去年同期比較。

marketFundamentalsRatioNote.en: pp = percentage-point change in the margin. Growth rates are blank when the base period is zero or negative.
marketFundamentalsRatioNote.zh: pp = 比率增減的百分點。基期為零或負值時不計算成長率。

marketFundamentalsDerivedQuarter.en: Single quarter derived from official cumulative values; EPS stays as reported.
marketFundamentalsDerivedQuarter.zh: 單季金額由官方累計值相減推導；EPS 保留原始申報值。

marketHistorySelectStock.en: Select a stock to load daily history.
marketHistorySelectStock.zh: 選擇股票以載入每日歷史資料。

marketHistoryInstitutionalDescription.en: Foreign and investment trust net trading · shares · hover bars for date and values
marketHistoryInstitutionalDescription.zh: 外資與投信買賣超 · 股數 · 移到柱狀查看日期與數值

marketHistoryMarginDescription.en: Hover charts for daily figures. Margin and short balances use lots; borrowed stock sold uses shares. Sells (margin sell, short sell, borrowed stock sold) are plotted below zero.
marketHistoryMarginDescription.zh: 移到圖表查看每日數值。融資融券餘額以張計，借券賣出以股計。賣出類（融資賣出、融券賣出、借券賣出）以負數軸顯示於零線下方。

marketHistoryOwnershipDescription.en: TDCC weekly distribution · all tiers in four groups (sums to 100%)
marketHistoryOwnershipDescription.zh: 集保週持股分布 · 全部級距分四組（合計 100%）

marketHistoryOwnershipHoverGuide.en: Hover each chart for its date and value.
marketHistoryOwnershipHoverGuide.zh: 移到各圖表查看日期與數值。

marketHistoryTierPercentAxis.zh: 持股級距 · 已發行股數比例 (%)

marketHistoryCollecting.en: Collecting history for this stock; the charts fill in automatically.
marketHistoryCollecting.zh: 這檔股票的歷史資料蒐集中，圖表會自動補上。

marketCustomSubtitle.en: Up to five stocks or futures, shown under the holdings.
marketCustomSubtitle.zh: 最多 5 檔股票或期貨，顯示在持股下方。

marketCustomSearchPlaceholder.en: Code or name, e.g. 2330 or TSMC
marketCustomSearchPlaceholder.zh: 代號或名稱，例如 2330 或 台積電

marketHistoryNoSpotTicker.en: No spot ticker is available for this futures contract; chart history is unavailable.
marketHistoryNoSpotTicker.zh: 此期貨合約沒有對應的現貨代號，因此無法顯示圖表歷史資料。

marketHistoryTaifexAggregateDescription.en: TAIFEX participant totals for the futures product category; not contract-specific positions.
marketHistoryTaifexAggregateDescription.zh: TAIFEX 期貨商品類別法人彙總，並非個別契約部位。

marketHistorySpotDataUnavailable.en: This panel requires an underlying stock ticker and is unavailable for index futures.
marketHistorySpotDataUnavailable.zh: 此面板需要對應現貨股票代號，指數期貨無此資料。

marketHistorySpotInstitutionalDescriptio.en: spot ticker foreign and investment trust net trading · shares · hover bars for date and values
marketHistorySpotInstitutionalDescriptio.zh: 現貨代號外資與投信買賣超 · 股數 · 移到柱狀查看日期與數值

marketHistoryNoStored.en: No stored history yet; first collection may take a few minutes.
marketHistoryNoStored.zh: 尚無已存歷史；首次回補可能需要幾分鐘。

marketHistoryUnavailable.zh: 歷史資料暫時無法取得。

marketHistoryNoRows.en: No historical rows are available yet.

marketHistoryChartGuide.en: Move over a candle for daily OHLC. Click to pin a date; drag to compare closing prices.
marketHistoryChartGuide.zh: 移到 K 棒查看當日 OHLC；點一下固定日期，按住拖曳可比較起訖收盤價。

portfolioHistoryDescription.en: Taiwan estimated total assets · daily closing snapshot
portfolioHistoryDescription.zh: 台灣預估總資產 · 每日最後一筆估值

leverageFormulaCombined.en:
Taiwan: (futures exposure + stock value + cash) ÷ Taiwan assets
Overseas: gross position value ÷ net liquidation
Combined: (TW position exposure + overseas positions) ÷ combined assets
leverageFormulaCombined.zh:
台灣：（期貨曝險＋股票市值＋現金）÷ 台灣總資產
海外：海外總持倉市值 ÷ 海外淨清算價值
合併：（台灣持倉曝險＋海外持倉市值）÷ 合併總資產

leverageFormulaTaiwan.en: Taiwan: (futures exposure + stock value + cash) ÷ Taiwan assets
leverageFormulaTaiwan.zh: 台灣：（期貨曝險＋股票市值＋現金）÷ 台灣總資產

adminOnlyContact.en: This feature is available to administrators. Please contact an administrator.
adminOnlyContact.zh: 此功能僅供管理員使用，請聯繫管理員。

tagline.en: Although each article focuses on a single topic, it often contains a variety of key knowledge points. By identifying and connecting these same points across different articles, you can build a more comprehensive understanding.
tagline.zh: 雖然每篇文章都集中在單一主題，但通常包含多種關鍵知識點。透過識別並連結不同文章中的相同知識點，你可以建立更全面的理解。
